summary: A shadow merge-queue signer for the signing host: two systemd user timers record every merge-queue entry (group tree, git merge-tree equality, a depth-1 predicted tree, the queue's own gate times and results) and sign host notes for the predicted or queued trees of our own authors with every local check, so tree equality, note-before-gate timing, run and slot-wait times and result agreement are measured. Host notes never cover merge_group runs, so it skips and blocks nothing.

replay.detail: No record or signature format changes: the notes are the ones st-test already makes.

schema.detail: No stored or wire format changes; the signer keeps its own local state files under ~/.local/state/evidence-queue-signer.

rules.detail: What counts as evidence is unchanged: the policy is not edited, and host notes still never cover a merge_group run.

compatibility.detail: Nothing runs until the units are installed on a host.

manual.detail: On the signing host, after sign-off: copy scripts/evidence-queue-timer to ~/.local/bin and the four evidence-queue unit files to ~/.config/systemd/user, optionally write ~/.config/evidence-queue-signer/next-command, then systemctl --user enable --now evidence-queue-observe.timer evidence-queue-sign.timer.

recovery.detail: touch ~/.config/evidence-queue-signer/off stops both; systemctl --user disable --now the two timers removes it.
